findings.title: Missing React key for Grafana rules in filter view
findings.body: In FilterView.tsx the grafana branch renders GrafanaRuleListItem without a key prop, while the datasource branch passes key={key}. Without a stable key React warns and cannot correctly reconcile the infinite-scrolling list, causing state leakage between rows, wrong row updates on load-more/filter, and degraded performance.

findings.title: Pause action can never show in prom-only list view
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu computes canPause as OR of ruler and Grafana prom abilities, implying prom-only rules should be pausable, but rendering additionally requires rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) to be truthy. In the new list view rulerRule is undefined, so the Pause menu item never renders even when the user has pause permission. Users lose Pause from the list view.

findings.title: Delete action can never show in prom-only list view
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu computes canDelete as OR of ruler and Grafana prom abilities, but rendering is gated on canDelete && rulerRule. In the new list view only promRule is passed and rulerRule is undefined, so Delete never appears even for users with delete permission. The computed Grafana delete ability is dead code and delete is regressed.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for prom-only rules
findings.body: RuleActionsButtons sets showSilenceDrawer true when Silence is clicked from AlertRuleMenu, which now appears via Grafana prom abilities, but the drawer is only rendered if rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) where rule is the optional ruler rule. In the prom-only list view rule is undefined, so the condition is always false and clicking Silence notifications does nothing with no error.

findings.title: skipToken still grants Duplicate for non-Grafana rules
findings.body: useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities maps skipToken to undefined and calls useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined). For undefined the hook still returns supported=true for Duplicate based on Grafana create permission. ORed with ruler abilities in AlertRuleMenu, this shows Duplicate for data-source rules to users who have Grafana rule create but lack external write permission, over-exposing the action.

findings.title: Federated rule protection removed
findings.body: The old useAllAlertRuleAbilities checked isFederatedRuleGroup to mark federated groups immutable and block Update/Delete/Pause. The new useAllRulerRuleAbilities hardcodes isFederated to false with a TODO. Federated Mimir rules now appear editable, removable and pausable in the UI, allowing users to attempt mutations that should be blocked.

findings.title: Rule view link drops returnTo navigation
findings.body: The previous GrafanaRuleListItem built the view href with createReturnTo and passed returnTo as a query param so the detail page can navigate back to the filtered list. The new GrafanaRuleListItem builds href as /alerting/grafana/<uid>/view without returnTo, so Back navigation from the rule view loses list context.

findings.title: Newly created rules disappear until Prometheus syncs
findings.body: GrafanaGroupLoader previously merged ruler and Prometheus and rendered ruler-only rules as Creating and prom-only rules as Deleting to hide eventual consistency. It now renders only promResponse rules. A rule just created in the ruler but not yet in Prometheus vanishes from the list instead of showing Creating, and recently deleted rules appear as normal, confusing users and inviting duplicate creates or repeated edits.
